summary: Serve Robotics Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 17, 2026, furnished under Item 7.01 with a press release and disclosing under Item 8.01 lower-than-expected delivery volume and reduced demand through its Uber Eats partnership. The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change. It is a routine current report updating operational performance and forward-looking statements. No deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic transaction are announced. The appropriate classification is None, as the filing represents ordinary business disclosure without triggering a special-situations category.
